Preserve the actual narrow side-face view, head roll, and serious closed mouth. Retain the source-visible short grey temple hair and actual brow hair, with a smooth upper lip and chin lacking prominent separate moustache or beard, keeping subtle source shading understated. The dark navy open uniform jacket features a pale white-grey pointed shirt collar and only a small dark neckwear area exposed beside the note; do not invent bright ties, hidden badges, or ribbon rows. Ensure the rounded chin immediately meets the raised and broadened existing neckline, creating a very short broad neck transition with minimal throat exposure. Avoid separate yellow neck shafts, pointed V funnels, pinched collars, neck rolls, floating collars, clipping, or cream belly bibs. Preserve the exact observed OPEN uniform and actual shirt/neckwear and actual fastening, maintaining coherent front and rear collar overlap and contact shadows. Retain the complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its exact original color, and the attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces must remain opaque, with alpha only outside the complete card silhouette. Do not invent insignia, text, or accessories. Keep fine primary details indistinct and understated, preserving exact primary lighting, grey backing, frame, crop, and note overlap without spectacles or readable cap-band engraving.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: IMAGE-LEFT near-PROFILE naval bust, preserve actual narrow side-face view/head roll and serious CLOSED mouth. DARK NAVY/BLACK peaked cap with broad GOLD geometric/leaf band and dark visor, source-visible short GREY temple hair and actual brow HAIR. Smooth upper lip/chin without prominent separate moustache/beard; subtle source shading stays understated. Dark NAVY OPEN uniform/jacket with pale WHITE/GREY pointed shirt collar and only small dark neckwear area exposed beside note; no invented bright tie, hidden badges or ribbon rows. Keep exact primary lighting, grey backing, frame, crop and note overlap. No spectacles; fine cap-band engraving not readable text.
Preserve exact source head angle and expression. Whole yellow area above raised/broadened neckline is one compact near-round head, with clearly rounded chin immediately contacting the very short broad collar transition, no additional separate neck shaft or pointed V. Image1 is the exact original small card; Image2 identity only. Fine markings indistinct in Image1 must remain understated, not invented as a readable symbol.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
